title: Critical Security: Command Injection in Folder Packer Pro
body: The `Folder Packer Pro` tool uses `os.system` with interpolated strings (e.g., `os.system(f'open {log_filename}')`), which allows for arbitrary command execution if the filename contains shell metacharacters. This must be replaced with `subprocess.run` and proper argument handling immediately.

title: High Security: Path Traversal Vulnerability in PDF Renamer
body: The `PDF Renamer` relies on an AI model for filename generation but does not explicitly verify that the output lacks directory traversal sequences (`../`). While `sanitize_filename` is used, explicit test cases and containment checks (e.g., `path.is_relative_to()`) are required to prevent file system overwrite attacks.

title: High Security: Zip Bomb Vulnerability in Folder Tools
body: The `Folder Tool` and `Folder Packer Pro` extract archives without checking for compression ratios or absolute decompressed size limits. This exposes the application to 'Zip Bomb' Denial of Service attacks. Implement limits on extraction size and ratio.

title: Security: Insufficient Input Sanitization in Calculator
body: The Calculator web app only checks for `__` to prevent malicious input. This is insufficient for preventing Denial of Service via complex calculations (`sp.simplify`). While not an RCE risk in the current deployment, it is a robustness failure. A computation timeout mechanism is required.
